name: Agent liability underwriter
oneLiner: When an agent books the slot or signs the order, someone has to price the mistake. No market for that exists yet.
why: Delegating real actions — payments, bookings, orders — to agents creates a liability question every deployment currently answers informally
Insurance has a track record of turning new technologies into priced products
threats: Contract law may absorb the question by pinning liability on existing roles
Agents that log everything may make the risk priceable enough that no human underwriter is needed
